g.text: HEART | Post-outcome sensitivity | Same four hospitals and consumed outcomes
Dots on the right show the observed difference; lines show 95% intervals conditional on the observed hospitals.
Both familywise intervals cross zero. V4 was highlighted after inspecting outcomes; it is not a new confirmatory winner.
